t: A Silicon Labs wireless chip for Matter, Thread, Zigbee, and Bluetooth smart home devices.
steps: Buy the xG26 Explorer Kit from Silicon Labs or a distributor.
Get a USB cable for the kit.
Install Simplicity Studio or set up Zephyr on your computer.
Open the Zephyr board guide for the xG26 kit.
Build and flash the Blinky example to the kit.
Try a Bluetooth example next and find the board with a phone app.
Move on to a Thread or Matter example with a smart home hub.
meta: Open Code. From $35. A few stores.
